text:
incident-bot: Pager alert: spike in 5xx from eu-west1 -> apac routes. Error rate 12% above baseline, rolling ~07:14 UTC. Potential region-pin mismatch after policy deploy. :rotating_light:

mira (oncall): grabbing it. seeing doubled 5xx in the steering dashboard. rolling-window shows failed handoffs at egress edge around eu-west1 -> apac.

lee (netops): noticed a policy commit at 07:07 by `policy-operator` that changed weightings and introduced a pin override for a subset of prefixes. suspect the operator didn't include the fallback route, causing requests to land in apac with incompatible backend.

mira (oncall): good call. can we diff the applied policy vs previous? alex, can the control plane show the exact policy id and hash?

alex (platform): running `rdctl routing list --region eu-west1 --since 2026-03-15T07:00Z` now. output snippet: ```json
{"policy_id": "p-78a9", "applied_at": "2026-03-15T07:07:12Z", "rules": [{"match":"/generate","pin":"apac-1","weight":1.0}]}
``` Looks like a full pin for that route. previous policy had weighted steering with fallback.

mira (oncall): impact scope? which customers hitting this?

customer-success: earliest reports from two customers in fintech and messaging. errors are HTTP 502/504 and timeouts. telemetry shows ~350k requests in last 5m, ~42k errors (12%).

lee (netops): pushing a quick diff check: `rdctl routing show p-78a9 --diff p-77z3` returned: removed fallback block `fallback: global-route` line. operator template was mis-parameterized.

mira (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) revert to p-77z3 (previous policy) 2) if revert delayed, apply emergency override to unpin route to weighted steering 3) communicate to customers. I'll start revert.

alex (platform): initiating revert: `rdctl routing apply --policy p-77z3 --force` -> kicked off. deploy-bot: canary rollout started.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback initiated for policy p-78a9 -> p-77z3. Progress: canary 0/10 nodes done.

mira (oncall): monitoring metrics. switching route diagnostics to verbose.

lee (netops): while rollback proceeds, we can apply a temporary network-level override at the edge to map the /generate prefix back to eu-west1 balanced pool. Command: ```curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/edges/overrides -d '{"prefix":"/generate","mode":"weighted","weights":{"eu-west1":1,"apac-1":0}}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'```

alex (platform): override accepted, 1/3 edge rings updated.

mira (oncall): metrics: error rate dropping to 6% after first ring update. keep going.

customer-success: beginning outreach to affected customers: initial impact message queued, will update once rollback finishes.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback progressed: 6/10 nodes. No config errors.

mira (oncall): double-check KV cache implications for the pinned sessions. Is KV cache causing sticky failures?

lee (netops): good point. the pin set also changed KV namespace mapping — requests pinned to apac backend with older KV schema; mismatch causing 502s. after override, traffic should hit eu-west1 schema-compatible backends.

alex (platform): rollback complete: 10/10 nodes. policy p-77z3 active.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete. No failed nodes.

mira (oncall): verifying end-to-end: error rate now ~1.8% baseline. latency normalizing.

customer-success: sent update to customers: root cause suspected policy operator bug; mitigation applied; followup postmortem promised.

lee (netops): follow-up action items: 1) add pre-deploy validation that fallback exists for pin edits 2) add canary gate that prevents full pin without fallback if traffic > X rps 3) write a small check in operator template to ensure KV mapping compatibility.

alex (platform): opened infra ticket INFRA-3124 for validation gates and gating logic. included example test harness and patch suggestion.

mira (oncall): handing off to night oncall Sam in 30m. summary: accidental pin-only policy p-78a9 caused EU->APAC misroute and schema mismatch 07:07 UTC, rollback to p-77z3 restored weighted steering and reduced errors. customer outreach in progress. postmortem scheduled. see notes above. :white_check_mark:

sam (night-oncall): acked. I'll monitor for 2h and keep CS looped. if we see reappearance, escalate to vendor networking team and open bridge.

mira (oncall): creating incident bridge and adding context for Sam: https://bridges.internal/icmp/4501236789

deploy-bot: incident ticket INC-2026-4501 created and linked.

mira (oncall): quick note for postmortem: include the operator template, policy diff, KV schema mapping, and customer-impact timeline. assign owners: lee for root cause fix, alex for gating, cs for comms.

sam (night-oncall): thx. passing to me now. Good handoff all. :raised_hands:

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. updates will be posted to this thread.
